title: 22nd Singapore Graduate Forum on Southeast Asian Studies
institution: Asia Research Institute, National University of Singapore
field: Southeast Asian Studies (humanities and social sciences)
level: PhD students and recent PhD recipients
about: The Asia Research Institute at NUS invites PhD students who have completed fieldwork and recent PhD recipients to apply to its 22nd Singapore Graduate Forum on Southeast Asian Studies, held online 7-11 June and at NUS 14-18 June 2027. Applications close 4 December 2026.
requirements: Current PhD students who have completed fieldwork, or recent PhD recipients (awarded 2025 or later)
Recommendation letter from thesis supervisor or a senior scholar
Draft paper of 2,000-3,000 words by 31 May 2027 if selected

upskill.name: AI for Education
why: "Abstract of 300-400 words" and "Draft paper of 2,000-3,000 words" → AI for Education Academy course objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis" (A010.07 scored below 6 on the shortlist, so the Academy page is linked)
